options.hint: HTTP so'rovlar parallel; queue — fon vazifalar.
DB bilan aloqasi yo'q — fon ish.
Email — tipik misol; har qanday sekin ish.

questions.explanation: `php artisan make:job SendWelcomeEmail` → `ShouldQueue` → `SendWelcomeEmail::dispatch($user)`. `sync` driver — darhol (lokal/test). Production: Redis + Horizon (dashboard, autoscale) yoki Supervisor bilan `queue:work`. Mail/Notification `ShouldQueue` — avtomatik navbatda.

options.text: `Cache::remember('key', $ttl, fn() => hisob)` — bor bo'lsa qaytaradi, yo'q bo'lsa hisoblab saqlaydi; `get/put/forget/forever`; driver — Redis (production), file, array (test), database; tag'lar (Redis/Memcached) — guruhlab o'chirish; kalit nomlash konvensiyasi muhim

options.hint: Aniq kod kerak — Laravel so'rovlarni o'zi cache'lamaydi.
Sessiya — alohida; cache — har qanday ma'lumot.
`database` driver bor, lekin odatda Redis — xotira.

questions.explanation: `Cache::remember` ichida exception — cache'ga yozilmaydi (yaxshi). `rememberForever` — invalidatsiya qo'lda. Lock: `Cache::lock('key', 10)->get(fn)` — stampede'dan himoya (`Cache::flexible` 11.23+ — stale-while-revalidate). Kalit kolliziya — prefiks (`user:{$id}:profile`).

questions.prompt: Laravel event va listener qanday ishlaydi?

options.text: Event — "nima bo'ldi" ob'ekti (`OrderShipped`), listener — reaksiya (`SendShipmentNotification`); `event(new OrderShipped($order))` yoki `OrderShipped::dispatch()`; `EventServiceProvider` yoki auto-discovery bog'laydi; listener `ShouldQueue` — asinxron; bir event — ko'p listener (decoupling)

options.hint: Server tomonida — ilova ichidagi hodisalar.
Teskari — event dispatch qilinadi, listener javob beradi.
Model event — bir tur; o'z domen event'lar — asosiy.

questions.explanation: Qachon event: bir harakatga bir nechta mustaqil reaksiya (email + analitika + ombor), modul chegaralari orasida. Qachon emas: oqim aniq va bitta bo'lsa — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chaqiruv (event yashirin oqim). `Event::fake()` testda. Subscriber — bir klassda ko'p listener.

questions.prompt: Queue job'da retry, timeout va failure qanday boshqariladi?

options.text: `$tries` (yoki `retryUntil()`), `$backoff` (sekund yoki massiv — exponential), `$timeout` (worker `--timeout` dan kichik), `$maxExceptions`; `failed(Throwable $e)` metodi — oxirgi urinish yiqilganda (alert, holat); `failed_jobs` jadvali + `queue:retry`; `$uniqueFor`/`ShouldBeUnique` — takror dispatch'dan; `RateLimited` middleware — tashqi API limiti
Job yiqilsa yo'qoladi, hech narsa qilib bo'lmaydi
options.hint: `failed_jobs` + retry; `tries` avtomatik qayta urinish.
Doimiy xato (noto'g'ri ma'lumot) — abadiy sikl, navbat band.
Osilgan job worker'ni band qiladi; `timeout` + `retry_after` (driver) muvozanati.

questions.explanation: Tuzoq: `retry_after` (config) `timeout`dan katta bo'lishi shart — aks holda job ikki marta ishlaydi. Idempotentlik — job qayta ishlasa zarar bermasin (to'lov ikki marta yechilmasin). Job middleware (`WithoutOverlapping`, `ThrottlesExceptions`). Horizon — failed job'larni UI'da ko'rish/retry.

questions.code:
<?php
class ProcessOrder implements ShouldQueue {
    use Queueable;

    public function __construct(public Order $order, public Request $request) {}

    public function handle() {
        $this->order->status = 'processing';
        $this->order->save();
        Http::post('https://erp.example.com/orders', $this->order->toArray());
        $this->order->update(['status' => 'done']);
    }
}

options.text: `Request` ob'ektini job'ga uzatish — serializatsiya qilinmaydi/ma'nosiz (kerakli qiymatlarni DTO/primitiv sifatida); `Http::post` timeout/xato tekshiruvi yo'q — yiqilsa `status` 'processing'da qoladi; idempotentlik yo'q (retry'da ERP'ga ikki marta); `$tries`/`$backoff` yo'q

options.hint: Model — `SerializesModels` bilan ID saqlanib, qayta yuklanadi — to'g'ri (lekin eski holat ehtimoli).
Instansiya metodi — to'g'ri (DI ishlaydi).
ERP 30 soniya javob bermasa? Job qayta ishlasa?

questions.explanation: Yaxshiroq: `Http::timeout(10)->retry(3, 1000)->post(...)->throw()`; ERP'ga idempotency key (`order->uuid`); `failed()` da status 'failed' + alert; `$tries = 3; $backoff = [10, 60, 300]`. Job konstruktor argumentlari — kichik va serializatsiya qilinadigan (model, ID, DTO).

questions.prompt: Cache invalidatsiya strategiyalari Laravel'da qanday amalga oshiriladi?

options.text: TTL (eng oddiy, eskirish oynasi), yozishda o'chirish (model observer `saved`/`deleted` → `Cache::forget`), tag'lar (`Cache::tags(['users'])->flush()` — Redis), versiyalangan kalit (`user:{$id}:v{$version}`), event-driven (domen event → listener o'chiradi); `remember` + qisqa TTL + yozishda forget — amaliy kombinatsiya

options.hint: Butun cache o'chadi — stampede, barcha foydalanuvchilar sekinlashadi.
Foydalanuvchi profilini o'zgartirib, 1 soat eski ko'rsa — shikoyat.
Qilmaydi — dasturchi zimmasida.

questions.explanation: Tag'lar `file`/`database` driver'da ishlamaydi. Ko'p server — cache markazlashgan (Redis), lokal `array`/`file` emas. Octane'da in-memory cache (`octane` driver) — har worker alohida. Model `$with` + cache — relation ham eskiradi. Cache kaliti hajmi/soni — Redis xotira monitoring.

questions.prompt: Laravel'da job chain, batch va unique job'lar qanday ishlatiladi?

options.text: Chain (`Bus::chain([A, B, C])->dispatch()`) — ketma-ket, biri yiqilsa qolgani to'xtaydi; Batch (`Bus::batch([...])->then()->catch()->finally()`) — parallel, progress (`job_batches` jadvali), `allowFailures`; `ShouldBeUnique` — bir vaqtda bitta (lock cache'da); `WithoutOverlapping` middleware — kalit bo'yicha; `afterCommit` — tranzaksiya commit'idan keyin

options.hint: Chain — ketma-ket, batch — parallel + yakuniy callback.
Istalgan driver; Horizon — kuzatish.
Cache lock — `$uniqueFor` sekund, `uniqueId()`.

questions.explanation: Misol: 10 000 foydalanuvchiga hisobot — batch 100 chunk job, `then` — "tayyor" email, `progress()` UI'da. Chain ichida batch, batch ichida chain mumkin. Tranzaksiya ichida dispatch — `afterCommit()` (yoki `after_commit` config) — aks holda worker job'ni commit'dan oldin oladi, ma'lumot yo'q.

questions.prompt: Queue worker'larni production'da qanday ishlatish va monitoring qilish kerak?

options.text: Supervisor/systemd bilan `queue:work --queue=high,default --tries=3 --max-time=3600` (xotira sizishidan — vaqti-vaqti bilan restart), deploy'da `queue:restart` (eski kod bilan ishlamasin), bir nechta navbat ustuvorlik bilan, Horizon (Redis) — dashboard, autoscale, metrikalar; alert: failed job, navbat uzunligi, kutish vaqti; worker'lar alohida konteyner/pod

options.hint: Har job uchun framework qayta yuklaydi — sekin; `work` — daemon.
Kechikish 1 daqiqa, parallelizm yo'q; daemon worker kerak.

options.text: Worker'ni web server bilan bitta jarayonda
options.hint: FPM so'rov ishlovchisi — fon ish uchun emas; alohida jarayon.

questions.explanation: Worker eski kodni xotirada ushlaydi — deploy'dan keyin `queue:restart` majburiy (Horizon `terminate`). `--max-jobs`, `--max-time` — xotira. Navbat ustuvorligi: `high` navbat bo'sh bo'lgandagina `default`. Kubernetes: worker Deployment alohida, HPA navbat uzunligi bo'yicha (KEDA).

questions.prompt: Laravel ilovasini gorizontal masshtablash uchun qanday talablar bor?

options.text: Stateless web node'lar: sessiya — Redis/database (file emas), cache — Redis (markaziy), fayllar — S3 (lokal disk emas), queue — Redis/SQS, scheduler — bitta node (`onOneServer` + cache lock), broadcast — Redis/Pusher, log — markazlashgan (stdout → agregator), `APP_KEY` bir xil, config/route cache har node'da, DB ulanish — PgBouncer/ProxySQL

options.hint: File sessiya bilan ikkinchi serverda foydalanuvchi logout bo'ladi.
To'g'ri sozlansa — stateless, masshtablanadi.
Node yiqilsa sessiya yo'qoladi; haqiqiy stateless yaxshiroq.

questions.explanation: Scheduler: `schedule:run` har node'da cron bo'lsa — vazifa N marta; `->onOneServer()` (cache lock) yoki bitta node. Rasm yuklash — lokal `storage/` o'rniga S3 + CDN. 12-factor: config env'dan, log stdout'ga. Octane bilan — har node'da worker'lar, xotira sizishi monitoring.

questions.prompt: Laravel'da event-driven arxitektura va modullar orasidagi muloqot qanday loyihalanadi?

options.text: Modul ichida — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chaqiruv (action/service); modullar orasida — domen event'lar (`OrderPlaced`) + queued listener'lar (ajratish, kechikish qabul qilinsa); sinxron kerak bo'lsa — modul public interfeysi (contract) orqali; tashqi tizimlar — outbox pattern (event DB'da tranzaksiya bilan, keyin broker'ga); event versiyalash; event storming bilan chegaralar
Hamma narsa event orqali, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chaqiruv yo'q
options.hint: Oqim ko'rinmas bo'ladi, debug qiyin; event — chegaralarda.
Bog'lanish — modul chegarasi ma'nosiz.
Asosiy maqsad — ajratish va kengaytirish.

questions.explanation: Laravel event — jarayon ichida (yoki queue orqali kechiktirilgan); mikroservislar orasida — Kafka/RabbitMQ (laravel-kafka, enqueue). Outbox: event'ni `outbox` jadvaliga tranzaksiyada, alohida worker broker'ga. `Event::fake()` + `assertDispatched` — modul testlari. Spatie event sourcing — to'liq ES kerak bo'lsa.
